script_text: Brace yourself, Aries, because Mars ignites your Fire element with an explosive cosmic surge this week. Monday through Wednesday brings a harsh Mercury square Saturn in your 10th House sector. This stalls momentum, while a cruel Mars opposition blocks your 7th House love connections. The turning point arrives Thursday when Jupiter enters your 1st House, replacing doubt with blazing confidence and shifting the Fire element back into your favor. From Thursday through Sunday, a harmonious Mars trine Uranus in your 5th House sparks romantic flair. Creative abundance makes the weekend incredibly magnetic for both love and career opportunities. Tuesday is your worst day because the Saturn square paralyzes your decisions, whereas Friday is your power day because the Jupiter conjunction unlocks your 1st House charisma. Trust your ruling instincts to navigate the chaos and fiercely protect your Fire element from outside interference. Follow for updates.
